name: @provenflow/desktop
description: ProvenFlow as a desktop application for macOS, Windows and Linux (Electron): the editor and its server in one window, with native menus, file dialogs and file associations.

scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir
